fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2020 by $43.1 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: States 'do not currently hold any derivative financial instruments'. No fuel derivative activity since 2015.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 289,401 [2020] 470,939 [2019] (38.5)% [from 2020 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased by 61.0% from $804.3 million in 2019 to $314.0 million in 2020 due to 38.5% decrease in fuel gallons consumed from COVID-19 impact.

warnings: COVID-19 significantly reduced FY2020 fuel consumption; 10% sensitivity of $43.1M is substantially lower than prior/subsequent years
